scope: Four proof records 78,84,86,88 and formal definition alignment for83,85,87; raw source audit by a separate agent who did not author the production proofs. Author notes were available for file/claim mapping; this was not a blind audit.

records.normalized_claim: For a finite orthogonal Hilbert projector family with every range nonzero, the space of bounded operators supported on R is adjoint-closed iff R is symmetric, and is a unital star subalgebra iff R is an equivalence relation.
records.semantic_argument: Supported uses literal continuous transfer blocks and is proved equivalent to the underlying algebraic support predicate. Converse symmetry and transitivity use actual bounded rank-one operators between nonzero ranges. Identity support forces reflexivity. Sufficiency constructs an actual StarSubalgebra. RCLike covers the real and complex Hilbert settings; no finite-dimensional restriction or blanket bounded-block assumption is used.

records.normalized_claim: Packet-pure generation is actual module generation by a set whose vectors have support cardinality at most one; its minimum is attained. Local ranks use actual compressed corner algebras on grouped projector ranges.
records.semantic_argument: The cardinal infimum is over all actual pure generating subsets, its indexing type is nonempty, and its infimum is attained by well-ordering. Corner compression is e*T on range(e), hence literally e*T*e there. Closure and the identity restriction are proved. A local family retains outside indices as zero maps; local_proj_zero_iff identifies these precisely for nonzero original packets, and zero deletion preserves purity and rank. The corrected zero-or-range wording matches empty-index conventions.

records.normalized_claim: For finite packets in an acting operator algebra A, unrestricted seed rank is at most packet-pure rank, which is at most the cardinal sum of actual diagonal-corner seed ranks. The corner unit acts as the projector.
records.semantic_argument: The left inequality is direct inclusion of admissible generating sets. The upper inequality chooses attained minimal generating sets under each genuine corner algebra, embeds them into X, and proves their union generates by projector completeness and corner_action_ambient. The union cardinal is bounded by the cardinal sum. This works for arbitrary infinite dimensions and arbitrary cardinal ranks, including zero packets.

records.normalized_claim: Each actual generator transfer edge admits a surjective restricted block of some element of the actual generated algebra.
records.semantic_argument: The edge is TransferEdge P ops, not a supplied surrogate graph. The witness T belongs to Algebra.adjoin of the projectors and declared operators; restrictBlocks is the literal map from the source range to the target range.

records.normalized_claim: For the finite actual transfer graph, edge surjectivity gives pure seed rank equal to the cardinal sum of genuine local pure ranks over source strongly connected components.
records.semantic_argument: SCC is the quotient by mutual reflexive-transitive reachability. Source is proved equivalent to absence of incoming condensation edges. Finite minimality proves every vertex is reached from a source. Generated-algebra support proves source projection compression. The lower bound removes zero seeds, proves those actually lying in each source generate its corner module, and injects the dependent union of these nonzero seed sets into the original generating set. The upper bound chooses attained local minima; actual surjective blocks propagate range containment along actual paths. No source coverage, compression identity, generating conclusion, or graph certificate is assumed in the final theorem. The theorem in fact does not require nonzero original packets, so it includes the printed hypotheses.

records.normalized_claim: Packet propagation means actual edge surjectivity together with cyclicity of each actual diagonal-corner module.
records.semantic_argument: Cyclicity is the existing module Cyclic predicate for the genuine packetCornerAlgebra acting on its actual range. There are no extra local-rank-one certificates supplied.

records.normalized_claim: For a finite packet-propagating system with all actual packet ranges nonzero, pure seed rank equals the finite number of source SCCs.
records.semantic_argument: The upper bound chooses a cyclic vector at one actual representative vertex of each source SCC and propagates full packet ranges to every vertex. The lower bound proves every generating set has a nonzero source projection, then uses purity and orthogonality to inject Sources into the chosen pure generating set. Nonzero packet range hypotheses are explicit. The finite cardinal-number form is proved; no finite generation or dimension assumption is introduced.

inputs: BoundedStar actual support and bounded rank-one witnesses

GraphSourceCount actual cyclic representative seeds and pure source injection

checks.upstream: Pinned local Lean/mathlib sources, with universal final closure replay delegated to the release verifier. No numerical experiments or external literature assertions are used as proof leaves here.

findings.detail: The original second definition omitted zero when there are no packet indices. It now agrees with the earlier support-cardinality definition and packetPure_iff_zero_or_range.
The formal proof uses the sufficient bound cardinality at most the displayed sum; this is the most precise uncomplicated wording for the union.
Discard zero seeds explicitly before counting source subsets. The formal proof already uses nonzero local seeds and proves their dependent-sum injection.

release_limit: This semantic audit plus thirteen strict source compiles does not replace the final all-module fresh build and exact-name kernel replay. The root release process runs that check independently.
